📐 Mathematical Formulations & Kinematic Azimuths

1. Component Velocities (North & East in m/year)

v_E = (ΔEast / Δt_days) × 365.25 m/year
v_N = (ΔNorth / Δt_days) × 365.25 m/year

2. Root Mean Squared (RMS) Horizontal Velocity

v_RMS = √((v_E² + v_N²) / 2) in m/year

3. Horizontal Speed Magnitude

v_mag = √(v_E² + v_N²) = √2 · v_RMS in m/year

Azimuth Angle (Clockwise from True North)

θ_az = atan2(v_East, v_North) mod 360°
